scope: Offline IPK plan fallback only; no router command, APK or snapshot candidate policy changes.
customer: tmux stopped before transfer on OpenWrt 24.10.8 ramips/mt7621 mipsel_24kc, because local dependency selection could not satisfy librt.
findings: Official exact-release toolchain defines librt. A missing installed-package record alone does not establish a missing shared object.
Exact-release opkg definition describes recursive dependency resolution and pins opkg source 38eccbb1fd694d4798ac1baf88f9ba83d1eac616.
New UnsatisfiedDependency remains a ValueError for existing callers. Only exact local selection catches it to permit the existing network routes.
Malformed metadata, integrity errors, cancellation and post-selection failures still stop. Online simulation still rejects replacement of installed packages.
The change is hardware-independent and shared by Windows and Debian. Existing firmware profile, architecture and candidate guards remain in place.

supplemental_source.observation: noaction option is supported; current index, not exact-release proof

source_limitations: Pinned opkg implementation download failed TLS certificate verification; validation was not disabled.
